project: Ghoztty session persistence — build + thorough E2E test
userIntent: Build the hybrid local-agent session persistence (design doc §5) and prove it: simulate a binary upgrade where every window reloads intact — correct positions/splits, same screen buffers, processes still running (re-attached, NOT restarted). Test thoroughly, not just build.

loop: 1. On session start: read THIS file fully, then the design-doc sections referenced by the task you pick. Do not re-explore the codebase for facts already in keyFacts below.
2. Pick the first task with status=pending whose dependsOn are all done. Set it to in_progress (edit this file) before starting work.
3. Do the task. Keep it small; if it balloons, split it into sub-tasks in this file and finish only the first.

4. Verify per the task's acceptance. Build must pass; run the named tests. For user-facing changes, kill + relaunch the DEBUG app from this worktree and verify live (never while the user has live debug windows you did not create).

5. Commit on this branch: git add -A && git commit with a descriptive message ending in the Claude Co-Authored-By trailer. Record the SHA + outcome + surprises in the task's notes, set status=done (or blocked with reason).
6. Add any newly-discovered follow-up tasks to the tasks array (small, ordered).

7. If tasks remain: invoke the Skill tool with skill='dzearing-skills:reset-context' and args='Read /Users/dzearing/git/ghoztty-session-persistence/docs/design/session-persistence-tasks.json and follow its protocol: execute the next pending task, then reset context again.' — this clears context and re-seeds the next session.
8. If ALL tasks are done (or only blocked ones remain): do NOT reset. Write a final summary for the user: what shipped, E2E results, what is blocked and why.
rules: NEVER touch /Applications/Ghoztty.app in any way — it is the user's primary terminal. Debug app only: zig-out/Ghoztty-Debug.app (bundle id com.dzearing.ghoztty.debug, socket ghostty-debug-<uid>.sock).
All bundle identifiers stay in com.dzearing.ghoztty.* — NEVER com.mitchellh.*.
NEVER run +new-remote-window unattended against a possibly-unreachable host: a failed dial pops a modal alert that wedges ALL CLI IPC. Loopback dials to an agent you just health-checked are OK.
Use /usr/bin/log (never bare `log` — zsh builtin shadows it).
A `kill -STOP`ed process gets pending teardown signals delivered at SIGCONT — run freeze/thaw cycles in one tool call.

Stale-instance trap: after rebuilding, verify the debug app process start time > binary mtime before trusting live behavior. Kill any debug instance launched from other/deleted worktrees first (the user's real terminal is the RELEASE app; killing DEBUG instances is safe unless this effort created live test windows).
Agent test seam: GHOSTTY_AGENT_LOCK=<path> GHOSTTY_AGENT_HEARTBEAT=<path> lets a test agent run beside any real one. Agent flag is --listen=127.0.0.1:<port> (there is no --port flag).
Remote +split --name= never registers the pane (async) — target the WINDOW and use its focused pane, or use +list to discover pane uuids.
If the user interrupts with new instructions, encode them as tasks in this file instead of drifting.

environment.cli: zig-out/Ghoztty-Debug.app/Contents/MacOS/ghoztty +<action> … (or the ghoztty binary inside the debug bundle); debug socket is separate from release
environment.notes: Official zig 0.15.2 binary cannot link on this macOS 26.4 box; the brew zig@0.15 bottle works (see memory ghoztty-macos26-zig-toolchain).

decisions: Direction: design doc §5 hybrid — local ghoztty-agent owns PTYs; viewer keeps a layout+sessionId manifest; agent later gains disk metadata for reboot floor. User approved 2026-07-13 ('let's try it').
v0 local transport = loopback TCP (both ends already exist: agent --listen, ghostty_remote_connection_new_tcp). Unix-socket + peercred is a hardening task AFTER the headline E2E works (T09).
session-persistence is an opt-in config flag initially (default off) so the debug app stays usable throughout.
Ring stays 2 MB default for the demo; configurable size + 16 MB default comes with T11.
Reboot recovery (agent disk persistence, RELAUNCH) comes after the upgrade demo (T12/T13) — the upgrade scenario keeps the agent alive, so it does not need disk persistence.

headlineAcceptance.scenario: Simulated binary upgrade (what the user asked to prove)
criteria: Setup: >=2 windows, >=4 panes total with nontrivial split topology and distinct ratios, each pane running `echo PANE=<n> PID=$$; i=0; while true; do echo tick-<n>-$((i++)); sleep 1; done` (unique markers).
Action: capture +list --json snapshot; quit/SIGKILL the app; REPLACE the debug app bundle with a freshly-built one (simulating Sparkle swap); launch the new binary.

Pass: every pane's shell/child PID unchanged and process never exited (tick counter continued monotonically across the gap — no reset to 0); split tree (directions, ratios ±0.01), window count, titles match the snapshot; +read on each pane shows pre-kill scrollback lines (replayed) AND post-gap ticks; time from kill to all panes interactive < 10 s.

tasks.goal: Prove the toolchain + worktree build cleanly before changing anything; commit the design doc + this task file.
steps: Toolchain exports; zig build -Doptimize=Debug; zig build agent -Doptimize=Debug; zig build test-agent.
Launch zig-out/Ghoztty-Debug.app, verify +list works over the debug socket, quit it.
Commit docs/design/session-persistence.md + this file.

tasks.title: Agent: --port-file for ephemeral loopback listen
tasks.goal: Let a supervisor spawn `ghoztty-agent --listen=127.0.0.1:0 --port-file=<path>` and discover the bound port from an atomically-written file (tmp+rename). Needed so the app can spawn/find its local agent without a fixed port.
steps: src/remote/agent/main.zig: support port 0 in --listen (report bound port), new --port-file flag; write `{"port":N,"pid":P,"startedAt":...}` atomically after listen succeeds.
Reuse/extend listen-mode tests; add a test spawning with port 0 + reading the file.
tasks.acceptance: zig build test-agent passes incl. new test; manual: run agent with --listen=127.0.0.1:0 --port-file=/tmp/x.json, file appears with live port, nc connects.
tasks.notes: 2026-07-14: done, commit 382ca6ef7, in src/remote/agent/main.zig only. --port-file=<path> (and two-token form) pre-scanned order-independently; port 0 already parsed fine, real port comes from listener.listen_address (getsockname) — banner now prints the BOUND addr. File written atomically (tmp+rename, enroll.saveRelayEnv pattern) AFTER bind, fatal on failure. Body: {"port":N,"pid":P,"startedAt":MS}\n. 2 new tests (pure format + bind-0/write/read-back/dial); test-agent exit 0. Manual verified: file showed live port 59246 matching banner, pid matched, nc connected, no .tmp leftover. For T03: poll for the file AND liveness-check the pid in it; file is NOT cleaned up on agent exit (stale-file detection is the reader's job).

tasks.title: App: LocalAgentManager — find-or-spawn the local agent
tasks.goal: Swift manager that (a) locates a healthy local agent via its port file + HELLO probe, (b) else spawns the BUNDLED agent binary (ship ghoztty-agent inside Ghoztty-Debug.app/Contents/MacOS or Resources via the zig build) with debug-separated paths, (c) returns a dialed RemoteConnection handle.
steps: Build: package ghoztty-agent into the app bundle (src/build/GhosttyXcodebuild or the zig install step).

Swift: LocalAgentManager (new file under macos/Sources/Features/Remote/): paths keyed by bundle id (~/.config/ghoztty/local-agent-debug/{port.json,agent.lock,agent.heartbeat}); spawn with GHOSTTY_AGENT_LOCK/HEARTBEAT env overrides + GHOSTTY_AGENT_NO_SELFUPDATE=1; probe via existing ghostty_remote_connection_new_tcp (it completes HELLO before returning — that IS the health check).
Reuse Machine.isLocalMachine/isLoopback so no remote pill shows.
Idempotency: agent single-instance guard (per-lock-path) makes double-spawn safe (loser exits 183).
tasks.acceptance: Unit-testable path resolution; live: first call spawns agent (visible in ps, port file written), second call reuses it; connection handle dials and HELLO completes.
tasks.notes: Agent lifecycle: leave launchd packaging to T12; for now spawn-on-demand orphaned (daemon outlives app because it is NOT a child in the same process group — use posix_spawn with setsid or Process with detached semantics; verify app quit does NOT kill it).

tasks.title: Config flag: route local windows through the local agent
tasks.goal: New config `session-persistence = off|on` (default off). When on, NEW local windows/tabs/splits create their surface as a .remote backend attached to the local agent (fresh session per pane) instead of .exec.
steps: Zig: add config key (src/config/Config.zig pattern), expose to Swift like other keys.

Swift: at surface-creation sites that today produce local surfaces (TerminalController/BaseTerminalController newSurface paths), when flag on and no explicit remote target: obtain LocalAgentManager connection, inject remoteConnection/connectionKeepAlive (mirror BaseTerminalController.swift:428-475 remote-inheritance path), sessionId nil (fresh).

Working directory & command: pass through OPEN.cwd/OPEN.command (already supported by agent; per-host-defaults plumbing shows the path: SurfaceConfiguration.remoteShell → embedded.zig → termio/Remote.zig → OPEN).
Keep: pill hidden for local (isLocalMachine), title/OSC behavior unchanged (emulation is client-side).
tasks.acceptance: With flag off: zero behavior change (default). With flag on: new window's shell runs under ghoztty-agent (ps PPID chain proves it); typing/scrolling feels normal; +list shows the pane; kill -9 the APP → shell process survives (ps) — the core survival primitive, verified manually before any restore work.
tasks.notes: This is the highest-risk integration task. If Surface.zig/embedded config plumbing fights back, note findings here and split.

tasks.title: Manifest v2: persist layout + session ids on change/quit
tasks.goal: SessionLayoutManifest: for every persistent window, durably record {windowFrame, tabColor?, titleOverride, ipcName, tabs:[{splitTree with per-leaf {sessionID, title, ipcName}}]}. SplitTree is already Codable; add a parallel codable that captures sessionID per leaf.
steps: New Swift store (UserDefaults JSON or file under ~/Library/Application Support/com.dzearing.ghoztty.debug/), modeled on RemoteSessionManifest.swift incl. its mark-don't-drain crash safety and isQuitting preservation.
Capture session ids asynchronously like captureSessionID does (poll ghostty_surface_remote_session_id ~30s).
Update triggers: window close (remove unless isQuitting), split tree change, title change, frame move (debounced).
Do NOT wire restore yet — that is T06.
tasks.acceptance: Manifest JSON on disk matches live layout after making windows/splits/resizes; survives app quit; entries removed on explicit window close; unit tests for codable round-trip.

tasks.title: Restore at launch: rebuild windows + splits, re-attach every leaf
tasks.goal: At app launch (flag on), replay the manifest: recreate each window at its frame, rebuild the SplitTree with exact directions/ratios, each leaf a .remote surface with its recorded sessionID (agent replays ring → scrollback restored), restore titles/ipc names.
steps: Model on restoreRemoteWindows() (AppDelegate.swift:1365) + presentRemoteWindow(sessionID:), extended to multi-leaf trees: construct SplitTree nodes directly (native, exact ratios — do NOT shell out to +split/+rearrange).
Dead/not_found sessions: leaf shows exited state (reuse childExited overlay or a banner); do not crash the tree build.

Interplay: persistent windows must NOT also be restored by AppKit TerminalRestorable (avoid double windows) — gate restorable off for agent-backed windows like explicit-command windows already do (TerminalController.swift:69-74).
tasks.acceptance: Manual: 2 windows / 4 panes, quit app, relaunch → identical layout+titles, scrollback present, processes SAME PIDs still running. IPC names still targetable (+send-keys works post-restore).

tasks.title: E2E harness: scripted kill -9 survival test
tasks.goal: A repeatable script (e.g. scripts/e2e/session-persistence.sh or .py) that builds the full headlineAcceptance scenario via CLI, SIGKILLs the app, relaunches, and ASSERTS every criterion mechanically (exit nonzero on any failure).
steps: Drive via debug CLI: +new-window/+split with --command markers (see headlineAcceptance), capture +list --json, capture marker PIDs via +read.
kill -9 the app process; relaunch via open -b com.dzearing.ghoztty.debug (or direct binary); poll +list until restored.

Assertions: PID sets equal & alive; tick counters monotonic across gap (grep last pre-kill tick N, first post-restore read must show ticks > N with no restart marker PANE=… reprinted); split tree deep-equal (directions, ratios ±0.01); titles; +read contains pre-kill lines; wall-clock gap < 10s.
Teardown: +close everything, kill test agent (its lock path is the T03 debug path — never kill a NON-test agent).
tasks.acceptance: Script passes 3 consecutive runs; failure modes print actionable diffs. Committed with a README note.

tasks.title: E2E: simulated binary UPGRADE (the user's headline ask)
tasks.goal: Extend the harness with an upgrade mode: between kill and relaunch, REPLACE the app bundle with a newly-built one (new mtime + bumped build marker), like Sparkle does. Everything must re-attach intact per headlineAcceptance.
steps: Build a second copy of the bundle (or rebuild after touching a version string); rsync --delete over zig-out staged copy in a scratch dir — NEVER /Applications.
Also test the graceful path: normal quit (isQuitting) instead of SIGKILL, then swap+relaunch — both must pass.
Verify the agent process was untouched across the swap (same agent PID before/after).
Record results (timings, any scrollback truncation) in this file's notes and the design doc's acceptance table.
tasks.acceptance: Upgrade-mode script passes 3 consecutive runs for BOTH kill -9 and graceful-quit variants; agent PID unchanged; report written.

tasks.title: Hardening: Unix-socket transport (agent listen + client dial + ABI), make it the default local transport
tasks.goal: Replace loopback TCP with a 0600 unix socket + LOCAL_PEERCRED same-uid check (design §5.2 security rationale: any local user can connect to 127.0.0.1 ports).
steps: Agent: --listen-unix=<path> (socket_stream.zig is the Stream template); unlink-stale-with-livecheck; peercred check.
Client: ghostty_remote_connection_new_unix(path) through embedded.zig; LocalAgentManager switches; port-file becomes socket-path file.
Keep --listen TCP for dev/tests.
tasks.acceptance: E2E suite (T07+T08) passes over UDS; another-uid connect is refused (test with a root-owned probe or skip with documented manual check); tests added.

tasks.title: Agent: LIST_SESSIONS + `+sessions` CLI
tasks.goal: Wire session enumeration: new LIST_SESSIONS/SESSIONS frames (store already internally enumerable — tray.zig:33 pattern), and `ghoztty +sessions [--json]` against the local agent. Foundation for cross-machine attach later.
steps: protocol.zig frames + server.zig handler + tests; src/cli/sessions.zig modeled on list.zig but dialing the agent directly (not the app socket).
tasks.acceptance: test-agent passes; +sessions lists live sessions with id/state/attached/cwd/argv; documented in CLAUDE.md CLI section.

tasks.title: Agent policy: pinned sessions (no TTL), session cap 256, configurable ring size
tasks.goal: Persistent local sessions must never be TTL-reaped while a manifest references them; raise max_sessions 64→256; ring size via flag/env (default stays 2MB until measured; design target 16MB).
steps: OPEN gains pinned flag (additive, HELLO-compatible); reapIdle skips pinned; caps + --ring-bytes flag; tests incl. reaper behavior.
tasks.acceptance: test-agent passes; pinned session survives a fake-TTL fast-forward test; unpinned still reaped.

tasks.title: Reboot floor: agent disk metadata + RELAUNCH + launchd packaging
tasks.goal: sessions.json (atomic) with {id, argv, cwd, title, pinned, createdAt}; on agent start, load as dead-relaunchable; RELAUNCH frame restarts the command under the recorded metadata; install per-user LaunchAgent (com.dzearing.ghoztty.debug.agent for the debug lineage) RunAtLoad+KeepAlive.
steps: Persist on open/close/meta-change; tombstone on load; RELAUNCH handler; viewer: dead-session leaf offers/auto relaunch with '--- restarted ---' banner (config session-relaunch=auto|prompt, default auto); LaunchAgent plist written by LocalAgentManager.
tasks.acceptance: Kill -9 the AGENT → launchd restarts it → app reconnect ladder re-attaches → panes show relaunched processes with banner; reboot-equivalent simulated by full agent restart; E2E script variant added.

tasks.title: Reboot scrollback: ring disk snapshots
tasks.goal: Agent snapshots dirty rings every 30s + on SIGTERM; after restart, replay snapshot then a divider then live output (design §5.4).
steps: Snapshot format (offset+bytes), atomic write, load on start attaching to relaunched session; tests.
tasks.acceptance: Agent-restart E2E shows pre-restart scrollback + divider + fresh output.

tasks.goal: Update CLAUDE.md (new CLI/config), design doc status + measured acceptance numbers, memory files; write the final user-facing summary (do NOT reset context after this — report instead).
